instruction: I want to disable the background cone icon in VLC player. When VLC is paused or stopped, it shows a cone in the background which I find distracting. How can I turn this off?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the background cone icon in VLC. The evaluator checks the VLC config file for qt-bgcone setting, expecting it to be set to 0 (disabled). This uses the existing check_qt_bgcone metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) which contains the qt-bgcone setting
Metric function check_qt_bgcone correctly reads the config file and looks for qt-bgcone setting
Expected value of 0 is semantically correct - disables the background cone icon as required by instruction
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are loaded
Complete coverage - evaluator checks the exact setting needed to disable the background cone icon
Parameter handling is correct - metric receives rule parameter and accesses rule['expected_qt_bgcone']
Default value logic is correct - metric uses '1' as default if setting not found, which matches VLC's default behavior
